from common import *
import gzip, shutil

def main():
    save_source(__file__);harness('check')
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd
    from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
    prior=read(PREVIOUS/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')
    for tag in ['control_old','control_new']:check(prior['inputs'][tag])
    old=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/prior['inputs']['control_old']['path']);new=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/prior['inputs']['control_new']['path'])
    assert old.index.equals(new.index) and len(new)==5448963
    assert np.count_nonzero(old.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)!=new.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))==106
    with gzip.open(PREVIOUS/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz','rt') as f:inventory=json.load(f)
    for r in inventory['files']:check(r)
    shutil.copy2(PREVIOUS/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz',BASE/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz')
    checks={'original_changes':106,'training_rows':len(new),'source_manifests':[fingerprint(FEATURE),fingerprint(OLD_LABEL),fingerprint(VALID)],'provider_inventory':fingerprint(BASE/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz'),'inputs':prior['inputs'],'variants':{},'checks':[]}
    boundary={'original_float64_max_abs_change':float(np.abs(new-old).max()),'graded_float32_target_changes':{}}
    mu=float(new.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64).mean());sd=float(new.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64).std(ddof=0))
    expected_changes={3:0,7:0,15:1,20:2,30:1,50:2}
    for name in VARIANTS:
        n=int(name.removeprefix('quantile'));groups=grade(new,name);og=grade(old,name)
        scale=sd/float(groups.std(ddof=0));offset=mu-scale*float(groups.mean())
        y=(groups.astype(float)*scale+offset).astype(np.float32);oy=(og.astype(float)*scale+offset).astype(np.float32);y.name=oy.name='LABEL0'
        out=BASE/'data'/f'{name}-new.pkl';y.to_pickle(out)
        oldout=BASE/'data'/f'{name}-old.pkl';oy.to_pickle(oldout)
        count=int((groups!=og).sum());assert count==int((y!=oy).sum())==expected_changes[n]
        r={'bins':n,'scale':scale,'offset':offset,'scores':[i*scale+offset for i in range(n)],'new':fingerprint(out),'old':fingerprint(oldout),'new_signature':frame_signature(y),'old_signature':frame_signature(oy),'counts':[int((groups==i).sum()) for i in range(n)],'target_mean':mu,'target_std':sd,'actual_mean':float(y.astype(float).mean()),'actual_std':float(y.astype(float).std(ddof=0)),'rms_error_to_continuous':float(np.sqrt(np.mean((y.to_numpy(dtype=float)-new.to_numpy(dtype=float))**2))),'membership_changes':count,'encoded_changes':count,'paired_fits_needed':count>0,'identical_input_reuse':count==0}
        assert abs(r['actual_std']-sd)<1e-6 and abs(r['actual_mean']-mu)<1e-6
        if not count:assert np.array_equal(y.to_numpy(),oy.to_numpy())
        daily=groups.groupby(level='datetime').value_counts(normalize=True)
        r['daily_max_bin_share']={'median':float(daily.groupby(level='datetime').max().median()),'max':float(daily.groupby(level='datetime').max().max())}
        checks['variants'][name]=r
        d=np.abs(y.to_numpy(dtype=float)-oy.to_numpy(dtype=float));boundary['graded_float32_target_changes'][name]={'count':count,'max_abs_change':float(d.max()),'sum_abs_change':float(d.sum())}
        # Rational edges use lower-bin equality and never split original ties.
        idx=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([pd.to_datetime(['2010-01-04']),[str(i) for i in range(n*2)]],names=['datetime','instrument'])
        vals=pd.Series((np.arange(1,n*2+1)/(n*2)-.5)*3.46,index=idx)
        assert grade(vals,name).tolist()==np.repeat(np.arange(n),2).tolist()
        vals.iloc[1:3]=(2.5/(n*2)-.5)*3.46
        assert grade(vals,name).iloc[1]==grade(vals,name).iloc[2]
        print(name,'changes',count,'rows',len(y),flush=True)
    checks['checks']=['same5448963orderedrows','reference control pickles SHA verified','all frozen provider files verified','106 original float32differences','rational boundary and tied-midrank checks for alln','single affine transform fitted on reference training labels','paired old/new exact input identity diagnosed before fits','no reranking after grading']
    write(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json',checks);write(BASE/'docs/boundary-jump-audit.json',boundary)
    st=read(PROGRESS);st['status']='prepared';st['prepared_inputs']=fingerprint(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json');st['expected_fits']=sum(10 if r['paired_fits_needed'] else 5 for r in checks['variants'].values());assert st['expected_fits']==50;write(PROGRESS,st)
    print('Prepared all six n; expected actual fits50.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
